source_observation_scope: E1 only within the reported tested product/firmware, quantity and source boundary; fitted vertices are not independent laboratory observations
reference_product: 2026:A1 SAX Power Home Plus firmware V23.50

battery_cycle_efficiency.included_loss: Measured cycle already includes active-test battery/BMS contributions; do not add a second active BMS loss

aggregate_idle_power.application: Multiply by explicitly supplied idle exposure; never add during already-modelled active converter paths
aggregate_idle_power.allocation: Aggregate AC-energy accounting only; no observed DC/cell inventory allocation

applicability: One tested-product reference, no national product/fleet selection
Constant C and battery cycle efficiency are provisional outside their test profile, not observed one-way chemistry
Manufacturer approximately4W system standby and exact-system4.07W empty-state result support one provisional aggregate; revision/state transfer and omitted cell-powered idle loss remain debt
Known source curves retain explicit fit selection and supported power intervals
Synthetic Reference objects remain SCN/E3 and are not promoted by adoption of this method
A provisional aggregate idle-energy component may be calculated over supplied finite or annual exposure without resolving every component
The aggregate AC proxy does not alone determine physical hourly inventory, DC drain, peak flexibility or a complete annual system result

validation_debt.missing: Test-to-target power/state/temperature/capacity applicability of constant C and cycle eta
validation_debt.e1_upgrade: Selected-product boundary-consistent aggregate cycle/energy observations over the declared target duty and conditions, or a validated transfer/calibration; individual chemical one-way measurements are not mandatory

validation_debt.missing: State/revision applicability and whether aggregate standby includes cell-powered BMS/self-discharge
validation_debt.e1_upgrade: Boundary-complete aggregate idle-energy evidence at the selected product/firmware and relevant states/durations, with included/excluded terms explicit; component measurements only where needed to close that aggregate

validation_debt.missing: AC/DC loss-allocation convention for physical inventory/peak dispatch
validation_debt.e1_upgrade: Measured or otherwise qualified allocation and state-transition validation if that physical claim is activated; not a prerequisite for an AC aggregate energy debit

materiality.purpose: Claim-specific relevance and prioritization, not an additional universal E2 gate
not_claimed: upper bound on unmeasured cell loss
materiality.unresolved_loss_relation: For a separately established additional power p W over h idle hours, direct energy is p*h/1000 kWh before any required replenishment conversion. No p, exposure or decision threshold is selected here.

spi_boundary: Native SAX SPI93.1713% is a profile/tariff-dependent annual simulated cost-saving index, not an energy round-trip efficiency. It may support validation within its reference setup, never replace eta.
